{{Aquarius}}
Aquarius 7 is the 63rd day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 7th day of Aquarius, and it is a Sunday. It corresponds to ISO week 9, weekday 7.

Its informal Japanese name is 3宮7日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 63|Chapter 63]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152083}}.
